expr: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row]')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('T4 portal-approve')); if (!row) return 'NO-ROW'; const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Approve'); if (!btn) return 'NO-APPROVE-BTN: ' + row.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,60); btn.click(); return 'clicked Approve (2nd)'; })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row]')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('T4 portal-approve')); return row ? 'AFTER: ' + row.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0, 90) : 'row gone'; })()
